quizTitle: So and Such – Talking About Pets

questions.question: My dog is ___ friendly that everyone in the park knows him.
It’s ___ a beautiful cat that strangers stop to take photos.
Our parrot is ___ loud that we can hear him from the garden.
They have ___ a big aquarium that it takes hours to clean.
The puppy was ___ small that it could fit in one hand.
It’s ___ a loyal dog that it waits by the door every day.
Our rabbit is ___ soft that everyone loves to pet it.
They have ___ an unusual pet — a miniature pig!
The vet was ___ kind that our cat didn’t get scared at all.
It’s ___ a messy bird that we have to clean the cage every day.
Our dog is ___ excited when we come home that he jumps on everyone.
They have ___ a lovely pair of hamsters that even the neighbors visit to see them.
It was ___ a cold day that we had to put a sweater on the dog.
He’s ___ a clever cat that he can open doors by himself.
Our parrot tells jokes — it’s ___ a funny bird!
The kitten was ___ playful that it wouldn’t let us sleep.
It’s ___ an intelligent animal that it can learn its name in a day.
The dog barked ___ loudly that the whole street woke up.
They have ___ a sweet rescue dog that everyone falls in love with it.
Our cat is ___ lazy that it sleeps for 18 hours a day.
